title: Signal Sweep
premise: A pulse drone skims a futuristic scan grid to gather drifting signal wisps while jammer swarms try to shut the relay down.
interaction_model: Single-screen real-time pointer/touch steering on a full-screen canvas with one-button restart after failure.
objective: Collect as many signals as possible before repeated jammer hits deplete the shield.
progression: Endless high-score progression with escalating hazard spawn pressure as the score increases.
theme: Sci-fi cyber-radar signal recovery under electronic interference.
mood: Tense, clean, energetic, and slightly hypnotic.
likely_audience: Players who enjoy simple mobile-friendly arcade survival, score chasing, and dodge-and-collect reflex games.
confidence_notes: High confidence on the core loop: collect green/bright wisps, avoid red hazards, survive for score.
High confidence on input style because movement is driven entirely by pointer/touch position.
Moderate confidence on genre labeling because the game blends collection and survival more than fitting one narrow category.
Low uncertainty on presentation: the code explicitly frames the experience as a signal-sweep sci-fi interface.
recreation_prompt: Recreate a full-screen browser arcade game called Signal Sweep set inside a neon sci-fi scan grid. The player controls a glowing pulse drone in a single-screen arena using touch or mouse pointer steering, with the drone smoothly moving toward the pressed or dragged pointer position. The main gameplay loop is to sweep around the field collecting bright floating signal wisps for points while avoiding crimson jammer hazards that spawn from outside the screen and home inward. Each collected wisp should add score, trigger a satisfying pickup sound, a small burst of greenish particles, light haptic feedback if available, and a compact celebratory animated overlay. Each jammer collision should deal a large chunk of shield damage, create red debris particles, screen shake, danger feedback, heavier haptics, and warning audio when health gets low. Display a futuristic HUD showing total signals collected and remaining shield percentage, plus a short instruction line. Present the game in a sleek cyber-radar style with a dark blue background, luminous grid lines, scan-line sweep effects, glass-panel UI, and glowing cyan/green highlights contrasted with red danger elements. Make the game endless and score-driven rather than level-based, with difficulty ramping by increasing hazard pressure as score rises. When shield reaches zero, show a polished game-over panel with the final score and a restart button that resets the arena and immediately starts a new run. Keep it lightweight, readable, mobile-safe, and focused on smooth canvas rendering, responsive sizing, and a tight collect-versus-dodge survival loop.
